[comment by VoidLeech (collaborator)]
This was caused by C2ME logging an error every frame due to Create apparently using a random source off-thread (they currently have a stop-gap solution in place). Related to #9515. 
Discussion in the discord on solutions: https://discord.com/channels/620934202875183104/706162751642533909/1439854797925908570

[comment by EvieTheOwl (none)]
> This is caused by C2ME logging an error every frame due to Create apparently using a random source off-thread. Related to [#9515](https://github.com/Creators-of-Create/Create/issues/9515). Needs investigation.

Ishland has implemented a fix but it's a stop-gap solution. For now it just defaults to the normal random source if it detects it's being ran from the following class `com.simibubi.create.foundation.virtualWorld.VirtualRenderWorld`
